title: Next Closest Time
summary: Given a time in 'HH:MM' format, generate the next closest time using the same digits.
statement: Given a time in 'HH:MM' format, generate the next closest time using the same digits. There is no limit on digit reuse.
constraints: time is a valid 24-hour HH:MM string.
Return the next time, possibly on the next day, using only digits present in the input.
hints: There are only 1,440 clock minutes to inspect.
Advance cyclically by one minute until all four displayed digits belong to the original digit set.
Convert to minutes, increment modulo 1440, format HH:MM, and test its digits.
Minute-by-minute enumeration guarantees the first accepted candidate is chronologically closest, including wraparound.
editorial: Minute-by-minute enumeration guarantees the first accepted candidate is chronologically closest, including wraparound.

tests.explanation: 19:39 is the first later valid time using digits 1,9,3,4.
The next reusable time is 22:22 on the following day.
